source.source_name: NTA Corporate Number Publication Site (法人番号公表サイト)

parsing.notes: 30-column CSV, no header. Map columns by position (see source_field_catalog.json). Filter latest=1 for current state. Status = closeDate present ? closed : active. Convert full-width digits in addresses if normalizing. Download is a two-step public form: GET /download/zenken/ with a cookie jar to read the CSRF token (CNSFWTokenProcessor.request.token), then POST event=download & selDlFileNo=<fileNo> with the same session. fileNo for national Unicode CSV ~27194; per-prefecture varies per refresh — re-read the page each run.

mapping_rules.vat_id: null — no separate VAT; invoice number is 'T' + corporateNumber.
mapping_rules.legal_name: name (col7); legal_name_en = enName (col25, opt-in); legal_name_kana = furigana (col29).
mapping_rules.status: closeDate (col19) present => closed (reason closeCause col20); else active. Keep latest=1 rows.
mapping_rules.incorporation_date: NOT available — assignmentDate (col23) is number-assignment, not incorporation.

fixture_requirements: record with English name + furigana populated

live_test_plan.smoke: Download one small prefecture (e.g. Tottori) Unicode CSV via the form POST and parse the 30 columns.
live_test_plan.full: Download the national Unicode CSV (or all prefectures) and ingest; apply daily diff files for updates. Gate behind explicit env.
